text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... I did it—I managed to run all the way to the end somehow. ☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there's something kinda
fascinating about
the way she runs.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the decisions she makes on
corners are
pretty unique.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The basis of Copano Rickey's running
style is feng shui. It looks like certain
aspects of her unusual
approach have
left an impression on the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer! It looks like making the door orange really paid off! That race felt so good. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So, what should our next goal be?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If it's doable,
I want to win a big race as soon as
possible, to show everyone that
they can be
happy...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But there's one area that really needs improvement right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere that really needs
improvement... If
we're talking feng shui,
that would be...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Nope, nothing like that. What I need to work on is my strength!
choice_data_list: Like good fortune, or maybe the mo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm given a surprisingly grounded answer.
She also
provides a clear explanation.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui doesn't make miracles happen.
It's about creating the right environment
to ensure
you can fully utilize the skills
you already have.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's like how someone who's never kicked
a ball
could never beat a soccer pro. It's
the same idea.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is ultimately a doctrine that
exists to
help you fully accomplish
everything you're
capable of.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right now, there's a huge vortex of qi at
the center of the Twinkle Series. I'm not
saying that
success would be impossible,
but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just creating the right environment won't
get me
anywhere. I think it might be too
early for me to
take on a big race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like feng shui isn't some kind
of
all-powerful resource. For now, we
put off
deciding on our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Hokko Tarumae! Hokko Tarumae has
barreled through the competition and
over the finish line!
A well-earned G3
win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At long last, she's secured a graded race
victory! The angel of Tomakomai finally
has some great
news to share with her
hometown!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I did it...
I actually did it! I got my first
trophy for
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Tarumae! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Rickey. I had a feeling... that today—today— I could bring honor to my sash, and I finally did it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Your sash? You mean that thing you're
wearing
over your shoulder?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. The people of my hometown
gave it to
me. I love Tomakomai, and it
means more to me
than anything...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So they gave me a handmade sash, and
said I was the Tomakomai tourism
ambassador. But I never
felt like I was
living up to the title.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Until today!
I finally feel like I've repaid
that
kindness—at least a little bit,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow. That's great! I'm so proud of you,
Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like spring's finally come for
Hokko Tarumae—a racer who, while a
little ahead of us,
had been struggling
out there.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tarumae! I have an idea about how
you can
help your hometown even
more...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's feng shui-related, but would you like
to hear
it? I think it'll help you out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui? Come on, Rickey. We have to
get
serious here.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with having a
hobby, but a
runner's got to focus on
the people supporting
them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll see you later. Thanks for celebrating
with me
today.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Tarumae!
...Hmm. The people
supporting me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer. She's right, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good point! ☆ You know, I think
you're
starting to get the hang of feng
shui.
choice_data_list: Yeah, the people around you are pa...
Yeah, the people around you are pa...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, maybe I should take a leaf out of

Tarumae's book and surround myself
with more
people who'll support me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. How about we make our
next goal a two-in-one? I'm thinking we
should get more fans and also search for
fellow racers who'll support me. What do
you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first thing we need to do is create an
environment that ticks her feng shui
boxes. Instead of overreaching for a big
race, we decide to focus on
strengthening her foundation first.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Racers who'll support me... It's true.
If I'm
going to
get stronger, I'll need partners
like that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But can you actually think of anyone
who'd help me out? Hmm. I don't know
how easy it'd be to
find a dirt racer
who'd be on board.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right. This is the perfect time to let
feng shui
lead the way. ☆ The lucky
color that will guide
me to success is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Lend me your wisdom...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? Darkness? ...No, that's not right.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Black? So my lucky color's black. This
color is the
key to helping me gather
friends and fans!
